## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Sòng-period translation of an Indian Mahāyāna precept sūtra by **Dānapāla** 施護 ([施護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%BD%E8%AD%B7)) at the imperial Yìjīngyuàn 譯經院, late 10th to early 11th century.

**Abstract**

The text is one of the late-Sòng *bodhisattva-vinaya* translations from the Northern Sòng imperial translation project, recovering Indian Mahāyāna precept material absent from the older Chinese canon. Like the parallel Mūlasarvāstivāda translations of Yìjìng ([KR6k0023](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0023)–0040), these Sòng translations arrived too late to displace the established canonical literature, but they preserve significant Indian doctrinal-disciplinary material.
